messages:
harper: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — making a compact action retainer so we can track ownership. dropping items here for clarity. :clipboard:
mina: I'll take reconnect semantics and resume token flow. plan: preserve last-acked seq, keep 200-token soft buffer, resume from seq+1 on reconnect. due: 2026-04-07.
priya: server-side handshake + backoff changes assigned to me. using short-lived nonce + jittered retries (4). will gate with feature flag and add compatibility checks. due: 2026-04-08.
ross: ops request: infra should enable jemalloc on hot pods in canary and schedule GC tuning; aim to reduce 30s spikes noted in PM.
devops-bot: /action created enable-jemalloc-canary (owner: infra-canary) status: open check-interval: 6h
alejandra: observability I'll own: partial-response ratio, p95 stream latency, and regional panels. will add a runbook link to alerts. due: 2026-04-04.
mina: client note: expose onResume callback and linear backoff up to 6s. doc PR to include node+python snippet.
priya: server backoff config prototype: {"retries":4,"backoff_ms":[150,450,1350,4050],"handshake_ttl_s":50} — will post PR soon.
alejandra: draft prom rule for partials: sum(increase(chat_stream_partial_total[10m])) / sum(increase(chat_stream_requests_total[10m])) > 0.05 — alert with per-region labels.
ross: temporary mitigation: infra toggle to route to 'fallback-small' model when streaming error rate >4% for 15m. devops-bot, create toggle action.
devops-bot: /action created model-fallback-toggle (owner: infra-release) interval: 60s ttl: 1h
mina: staging soak after Priya's PR, ETA 48h; will attach transcripts and gap logs.
priya: PR opened: refs #2210 — in review. compatibility: node <=1.2, python <=1.0 fallback to non-stream.
alejandra: tracker summary (ISO dates): 1) mina reconnect impl due 2026-04-07. 2) priya handshake PR due 2026-04-08. 3) alejandra alerts/dash due 2026-04-04. 4) infra jemalloc + fallback toggle due 2026-04-05.
ross: please update the incident tracker row as you progress (todo / in-progress / done). I'll run a closure check next Tue. post blockers here and i'll escalate. :thumbsup:
